Configure current feature

  1. Author all four class catalogs and skill trees using registered example abilities/nodes; common body only. Validate prerequisite DAG and exclusive branch groups.
  2. Wire WBP_Skills to server spend/respec commands. Derived stats recalculate from level, gear and active talents once; no UI mutation or second attribute owner.

Run now: current-phase integrated scenarios

  1. A earns/spends a point in a valid Vanguard prerequisite chain. Attempt both mutually exclusive branches.
  2. Respec at suitable NPC with a quoted integer currency cost; atomically remove talents/refund points/recompute attributes and unlocked action bar.
  3. Repeat for Ranger, Arcanist and Warden example active/passive definitions; test interruption/prediction with missing magic visual placeholders.
Expected success
One accepted spend consumes the declared point cost; graph requirements and exclusivity remain consistent after respec/reconnect.
Ability availability follows accepted class/talent definitions, never a client-edited action bar.

Explicitly not active yet

  1. Example catalogs are not a complete balanced level1–50 library. Remaining art, talents and encounter balance require authored content expansion.

Expected rejection and concurrency results

SystemStimulus -> expected outcome
current-phase fixtureCycle, nonexistent parent, insufficient points, wrong class, stale build and invalid exclusivity reject before mutation.
current-phase fixtureRespec disconnect retains exactly the accepted build and debit; no partial talent reset.

Regression, disconnect and restart

  1. Restart the test environment twice; one admitted pawn per account, one local input context installation, no stale widgets.
  2. Repeat the previous phase success case after all new assignments; definitions missing from this phase must fail closed, not fall back to client saves.
  3. From phase03 onward run two separate clients; disconnect A while B remains, then reconnect with the correct identity.
  4. From phase05 onward query committed receipt/revision after timeout/restart. From06 onward reject old source epoch after transfer.

Stop condition and deferred work

Exclusive branches and prerequisites hold; respec cannot strand required progression.

Stop on a failed required assertion, missing required rule definition, duplicate authority or unverified dependency that this phase relies on. Legal debug art may support physics tests but cannot close the archive/PaperZD art gate. Do not activate future-phase systems merely because their full-game chapter exists.
